in_marathi.name: करण
in_marathi.long_meaning: करण हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karana refers to the cause or reason for an action. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kr', meaning 'to do'. In Hindu mythology, Karana is the name of a celestial being and the father of Arjuna and Bhishma Pitamaha.
